verdict.rationale: The evidence pack lists SDK integrations (LangChain, CrewAI, LlamaIndex, Vercel AI SDK) and coding-agent plugins (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex) but never mentions LiveKit, Pipecat, ElevenLabs, or any real-time voice pipeline integration, latency guarantees, or streaming-specific docs. Since Mem0 is a general memory API, voice-pipeline wiring is a fair and plausible axis, but there's simply no evidence it ships or documents this.
